budget_basis: Published peak rates, all input cache misses, CNY accounts confirmed by human; no fine-grained billing optimization
conditions_not_equivalent: Native thinking/sampling algorithms differ; Xiaomi forces temperature=1/top_p=.95, DeepSeek thinking ignores temperature=0 and uses provider-native sampling defaults.
Same numeric completion ceiling includes reasoning but tokenizers and allocation are not identical.
Mutable model aliases do not pin weights; IDs and raw metadata are retained.
Peak-rate estimates are not settled invoice costs; cache usage may be missing.
300s socket timeout is not a strict generation wall deadline, especially with keepalive.
No tools or agentic workflow; six public static diagnostic tasks do not establish formal rankings.
credential_availability: NOT_CHECKED; no credential files or values read during preparation
source_independence_caveat: Six distinct frozen source_incident_id clusters. Contract fixtures and synthetic controls are not six independently sampled real incidents. Same-author truth/evaluator construction is retained; evidence independence is not claimed.
stop_rules: No key access or requests before explicit human batch authorization plus rotation confirmation bound to freeze/entry SHA.
Reserve full request/token/cost ceilings in append-only trace before each single dispatch; never refund reservations.
Stop on auth errors, rate limits, model mismatch or missing model metadata, unsafe output, missing/invalid usage, token budget breach, measured timeout overrun or exhausted budget.
No retry, restart of an existing run, higher-token rerun, third model or automatic full comparison.
Answer/format/reason errors retain the frozen score; anomaly review never modifies evaluator during execution.
Interrupted reservation is an unresolved attempted request; do not restart or replay via network.
timeout_semantics: socket I/O timeout; no guaranteed total wall deadline; stop next dispatch on measured overrun
usage_missing_policy: Keep full cost/token reservation, estimated actual cost UNKNOWN, stop further dispatch; never infer zero usage.
